review: Opened the full-resolution extracted images; checked scientific labels and limitations against the authored explanation. Originals remain unmodified.

bindings.caption: Water transfers across connected stores — supplied textbook Figure 2.2.
bindings.explanation: Evaporation and transpiration move water toward the atmosphere; condensation and precipitation return water to surface stores. Runoff, infiltration, groundwater movement and springs connect stores. Arrows show selected pathways, not measured rates or a compulsory route for every molecule. The budget panel below concerns one pond, not this entire landscape.

bindings.caption: A numbers pyramid can have a narrow producer level — supplied textbook Figure 1.14.
bindings.explanation: This source illustration labels 200 trees, 150,000 herbivorous insects, 120,000 carnivorous insects and 2 birds. These counts are a different example from the authored plot table below. A tree is a large individual; many small consumers can depend on fewer producers. Bar shapes here do not measure biomass or annual energy production; the pictorial widths are not a calibrated plotting exercise.
